$comment: The Kubo (IPFS) binaries bundled with the app. scripts/download-kubo.cjs fetches them from s3://6529bucket/ipfs-binaries/kubo-v<version>/ and checks these SHA-256 values. They are the official ipfs/kubo release builds (each archive matched its published .sha512). Each version keeps its own S3 folder, so changing this file back rolls the binaries back.
